VARIABLE.NAME: TardiveDyskinesiaAssessment
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Persistent tardive dyskinesia assessed by clinician using history, neurological examination, longitudinal course and contributors. Unresolved includes withdrawal-emergent or spontaneous dyskinesia. Other tardive syndromes are not automatically TD.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: TardiveDyskinesiaAntipsychoticAssociation
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician attribution to antipsychotic exposure after assessment of alternative contributors; no causal inference by this model.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: TardiveDyskinesiaMotorSeverity
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-rated TD motor severity; meaningful only when TD is present. Do not fabricate a severity observation when TD is absent. No AIMS score cutoff.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: TardiveDyskinesiaDisablingImpact
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-assessed disabling TD impact, distinct from motor severity; mild motor signs may still be disabling.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: MildTardiveDyskinesiaTreatmentConsideration
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=At least one assessed reason to consider treatment of mild TD: patient preference, associated impairment, or psychosocial impact. Absence does not prohibit discussion.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: DoseReductionTemporalLink
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Dyskinesia began or increased around antipsychotic dose reduction; prompts longitudinal review, not an automatic waiting period or exclusion of persistent TD.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-identified urgent concern, including gagging/choking or immediate psychiatric safety risk. Psychiatric urgency is a modeler-proposed extension of source mood/suicidality concerns.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: VMAT2InhibitorCandidateSafetyAssessment
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=For a named candidate drug/formulation, clinician/pharmacist review against current local labeling: hepatic/renal function, hypersensitivity, CYP interactions, MAOI/reserpine and duplicate VMAT2 exposure, QT risk, mood/suicidality, sedation/falls, parkinsonism and other relevant precautions. ConcernsIdentified takes precedence if review is also incomplete. This aggregate is not an automated contraindication classifier; retain individual findings externally.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: VMAT2InhibitorTreatmentPreference
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Current preference about VMAT2 treatment; no inferred consent. Reconcile with any preference-derived mild-treatment consideration.
discretization=Modeler-proposed categories requiring clinical agreement; no numerical AIMS threshold

VARIABLE.NAME: AnticholinergicExposure
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Current anticholinergic use; review its indication and potential TD worsening without automatic discontinuation, especially with coexisting dystonia or parkinsonism.
